author.name: Ray Bradbury
author.heading: About Ray Bradbury
author.bio: Bradbury was an American writer of fiction, including Fahrenheit 451 and The Martian Chronicles. His advice to writers often circulated alongside his stories, making the distinction between an interview source and a later attributed maxim especially useful.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: Richard Dooling uses the saying while discussing rejection in a writer’s working life. Later quotation columns and a haiku essay repeat the Bradbury credit, but none of those inspected repetitions identifies the original interview, speech or book passage.
